articles.title: Show HN: A LinuxCNC gRPC Server with Clients in Rust, Go, Python, Node
articles.summary: A new gRPC interface has been developed for LinuxCNC machine control and its Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL). This project overcomes the limitation of LinuxCNC's native Python API, which traditionally operates only locally. By exposing the API via gRPC, it now enables remote monitoring and control of industrial machinery. This advancement significantly enhances operational flexibility and efficiency in automated manufacturing and robotics using modern network protocols.

articles.title: 10 Greatest Justice League Heroes Who Joined Since 2000
articles.summary: The Justice League, DC Comics' premier superhero team, has been a constant presence in the DC Universe since the early 1960s. Composed of the publisher's best characters, the team has undergone numerous transformations and evolutions over decades. They adapt their roster and storylines to new eras, reflecting enduring cultural impact and a rich fictional history within the comic book industry.
